parent_objective: audit incomplete public-gate core measured execution before any rerun, repair, ranking, or synthesis
blocked_by: M2101 measured execution is incomplete and reports metadata_missing_count 480
supersedes: direct ranking from incomplete measured execution
ad hoc rerun without failure audit

public_gates: M2102 must audit M2101 failure rows and metadata missing rows
M2102 must decide whether to route to metadata repair, scenario-sampling repair, rerun design, or synthesis
M2102 must not rerun measured execution or rank controller families
forbidden_shortcuts: do not weaken measured runner validation
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not treat smoke proxy rows as paper-valid generated tasks

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: classifies the incomplete measured execution result before any rerun or repair
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no ranking paper or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2101 failure cause is not classified
stop if audit proposes direct ranking
stop if audit proposes rerun before metadata/failure classification
stop if audit weakens measured-runner validation
fallback_plan: route to metadata completeness repair if metadata_missing_count blocks pass gate
route to scenario sampling repair if obstacle sampling failures are primary
route to synthesis if both blockers imply the public-gate measured branch needs redesign
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2101 produces incomplete measured execution artifact

training_stage.stage_objective: public-gate core measured execution result audit
blocked_shortcuts: do not rank from incomplete measured execution
do not interpret raw outcomes before failure classification
allowed_updates: M2102 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for repair, rerun design, or synthesis

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2102 audits measured execution completeness and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No history-necessity test is run in M2102.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If M2101 is incomplete, classify and repair the blocker before any ranking or paper claim.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: classifies the first measured execution attempt on the public-gate core panel
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can decide whether the measured branch needs repair or redesign; cannot support ranking before complete execution
must_synthesize_if: M2102 routes to another metadata bridge after M2098
M2102 cannot distinguish metadata completeness from scenario sampling blockers
M2102 proposes ranking from incomplete data

hypothesis: M2101's incomplete measured execution can be classified into actionable metadata and scenario-sampling blockers without overclaiming.
success_criteria: M2101 metadata missing rows are audited
no reset rollout measured execution ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: new reset or rollout is performed
ranking or paper-level claims are made

commands.name: audit
commands.command: audit runs/m2101_paper_route_outcome_supported_decisive_public_gate_core_measured_execution artifacts and write M2102 result audit

decision_rule: M2102 passes if it classifies the incomplete measured execution and selects a bounded next route without rerunning or ranking.
